comment: The terrain MCP surface a generated project gets once it installs @threenative/terrain. `tools` is set-equal to the tool table version 0.1.0 serves. Regenerate with `pnpm tsx scripts/capture-terrain-mcp-tools.ts`.

out.description: Relative directory that must not exist yet.

descriptions.terrain_generate: Choose from a request or explicit kit and cook one editable starter terrain kit (forest, coastal, alpine, desert or tundra) into a world.glb. Returns the kit as recipe, the world.glb, recipe.json and world.json paths, triangles, instances and draws measured from the produced GLB's default scene, and a ctx.assets.model load snippet. triangles counts every instance of the LOD0 default scene in full, before distance LOD and culling, instances sums the EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing instances, and draws counts primitives across instanced and non-instanced meshes, an instanced primitive counting once.
descriptions.terrain_patch: Apply editor commands (upsert, update, remove, move, toggle) to a terrain recipe and return the edited recipe.
